name: Liam
source:
Liam is a human teenager who lives in Rirudahna, and attends school there. He is chosen by the leader of the angels, Ruu, to mix a fragrance using the herbs of Flaithis, Rirudahna, and Annwn to try to bring peace between the warring Flaithis and Annwn once and for all. He is a gentle person who gets scared easily and also isn't very assertive when it comes to arguments, but he is also full of curiosity and may take rash actions because of this. Whether he ends up bright and gentle or strangely stubborn depends on the paths taken by the player.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/fragrance/fragrance.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
